g.title: b2_arguments
g.text: Why B-2 might, or might not, work: each argument, its evidence, and what tests it
green: for · red: against · amber: what decides it · labels:

g.title: hyp
g.text: B-1 lost because the agents reached the planner as a decoded list. Given the side-car's hidden layer instead,
in the module that makes the proposals, with the planner fine-tuned downstream, it plans better on navtest.

g.title: f1
g.text: slots a row at confidence ≥ 0.1: 36.4 · ≥ 0.3: 12.7 · ≥ 0.5 (the list): 4.75
argmax class, point box, 1 s path, no uncertainty ·
HD − D (the primary) · H6, all 128 slots

g.title: a1
g.text: labelled agents through a rule: −0.21 ± 0.05 on navtest; V2 not supported:
"a learned use is unlikely to show a NAVSIM gain" ·
going on is the owner's decision, D28

g.title: f2
g.text: The side-car reads what the projector may drop
it reads the 1024-d ViT tokens; the planner reads their 256-d projection ·

g.title: f3
g.text: A learned reader is not bound to a 1 s clearance
B-1's rule caught 1,949 of 40,595 failing proposals on navtest ·

g.title: f4
g.text: Planners elsewhere read agent queries, not boxes
(they train perception and planning together, on far more data)

g.title: f5
g.text: Retraining the refiner helped out of domain
first pass: 0.28–0.36 m closer to the human at 3 s on nuScenes,
C − R, on navtest and nuScenes

g.title: decide
g.text: O − C under B-2-1, the gate: is there room for any agent input to a learned planner?
HD − D under B-2-1, every seed beyond D's seed range and 2 SE: does the hidden layer add to the list?
HD − C · meets or beats R · H6 − HD · H3 − H6
no slots · another log's slots · another fold's side-car

g.title: a2
g.text: The release already learned this, more directly
each proposal's feature predicts its collision and TTC agents every 0.1 s
over 4 s, from all logged agents, out of view included (agent_pred) ·

g.title: a3
g.text: The room is in the pick, not the proposals
271 of 275 failing navtest scenes have a safe proposal among the 32 ·
the refiner's loss has no NC or TTC term ·
B-2-1's score loss; B-2-2's pass-4 read

g.title: a4
g.text: The planner is in-sample on navtrain
its pick fails NC or TTC on 0.81% of train rows (vendored,
): it is taught where it needs no help

g.title: a5
g.text: a slot's centre lives in its reference point, beside a; the ViT's position
every H arm carries the centre; H6 must learn the forecast

g.title: a6
g.text: B-1's failures are about horizon and view
they come after 1 s; 35% involve agents out of view ·
the slots see the same camera, trained to 1 s

g.title: a7
g.text: Seed noise may hide a real effect
first pass, F − C: −0.21 to +0.24 across seeds ·
